key.name: toggle-overlay
key.description: Keybinding to toggle the Aether overlay popup

key.name: providers
key.description: JSON object mapping provider IDs to their configuration (name, apiKey, baseUrl)

key.name: backup-provider
key.description: Provider to fall back to when the active provider fails after retries. Leave empty to disable.

key.name: backup-model
key.description: Model to use with the backup provider.

key.name: auto-summarize
key.description: Automatically summarize old context when approaching token limits

key.name: summarize-threshold
key.description: Fraction of max context tokens at which to trigger auto-summarization (0.0-1.0)

key.name: max-context-tokens
key.description: Maximum context window size in tokens for the active model

key.name: tts-enabled
key.description: Read AI responses aloud using text-to-speech

key.name: stt-model-path
key.description: Path to the whisper.cpp GGML model file

key.name: stealth-mode
key.description: Hide all visible indicators; only accessible via hotkey

key.name: system-prompt
key.default: 'You are Aether, an AI assistant embedded in the GNOME desktop on Fedora. You have access to tools to execute commands, manage files, search the web, and more. Always be concise.'

key.name: custom-main-prompt
key.description: User-defined custom prompt that defines Aether's behavior and personality. If set, this overrides the default system prompt.

key.name: include-agents-in-prompt
key.description: When enabled, automatically injects the list of available agent names into the main prompt

key.name: serper-api-key
key.description: API key for Serper.dev Google Search

key.name: search-max-results
key.description: Maximum number of search results to return (1-20)

key.name: db-path
key.description: Path to SQLite database. Empty uses default ~/.config/aether/aether.db

key.name: agent-configs
key.description: JSON object mapping agent IDs to their configuration (name, providerId, modelId, systemPrompt)

key.name: computer-use-enabled
key.description: Register screenshot, mouse, keyboard, and scroll tools for vision-capable agents

key.name: computer-use-screenshot-detail
key.description: Vision API detail level: 'low' (~85 tokens, fast) or 'high' (~765 tokens, detailed). Use 'high' when the agent needs to read small text.

key.name: computer-use-max-images
key.description: Maximum number of screenshot images kept in agent context. Older screenshots are removed to prevent context overflow. (1-10)

key.name: computer-use-action-delay
key.description: Delay in milliseconds between input sub-actions (e.g., mouse move then click). Higher values improve reliability on slower systems. (50-500)

key.name: computer-use-hide-overlay
key.description: Temporarily hide the Aether overlay before taking screenshots so the agent sees the actual desktop

key.name: computer-use-grid-overlay
key.description: Draw a labeled coordinate grid over screenshots to help the AI model estimate pixel positions accurately

key.name: computer-use-grid-spacing
key.description: Spacing between grid lines in logical pixels (50-500)

key.name: computer-use-target-resolution
key.description: Screen resolution to switch to during Computer Use agent runs. Lower resolution = faster processing and bigger UI elements. Set to 'native' to keep current resolution. Common: '1280x720', '1920x1080'

key.name: last-session-id
key.description: Session ID of the most recent conversation, used to restore state after screen lock
